shots.text: When the Sundered Heart fell, there was a man inside it. Very small, and very grey, curled around a locket.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The knot of shards collapsing in dawn light. In the middle, Cassivane on his knees, ash, locket in his hands.

shots.text: Father. I'm here. I was always here. You just had to stop.
shots.speaker: ilyra
shots.art_note: Ilyra kneeling in front of him, taking his hands.

shots.text: He looked at her for a long time. Then he gave her the locket, and the ash took him.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Cassivane's face, the grey leaving his eyes. He presses the locket into her hand and crumbles into ash in the dawn wind.

shots.text:
I felt the sun on my face. I could not see it, but I felt it.

Solenne stood.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Ysolde on the wall, face lifted to the light, crying, smiling. The six peoples cheering in the streets of a city lit gold.

shots.text: The Crack is still open. He is still out there. And for the first time since this began, we have something to bring to his door.
shots.speaker: oswin
shots.art_note: Oswin, Corvin, Tamsin and the Wardens around the Heartstone. Oswin looking east toward the Rift.

shots.text:
We had spent the whole war running.

Now we went to find him.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The army of the Concord marching out of Solenne's gates in dawn light, every hero and Warden at its head, toward the Rift.
